text: The paper reports that on graph isomorphism nip performs favourably, with verifiers learning to near-perfectly classify valid instances when interacting with the prover, while the adp, debate and mnip protocols see no increase in performance. The authors attribute this mainly to the task, which has a simple random-node query algorithm that adp cannot express and that is harder to learn with multiple provers.
title: Graph isomorphism: nip helps the verifier; adp, debate and mnip show no gain
